name: retichat-js
comment: The browser loads dependencies from the importmap in index.html; this file exists only so the test suite can resolve them under Node. Keep msgpackr pinned to the same version as the importmap.
comment-scripts: npm test skips the boot-gate tests that start headless Chromium (deploy_gates.test.mjs) and says so; npm run test:full runs them with RETICHAT_BOOT_TESTS=1. deploy.sh sets RETICHAT_BOOT_TESTS=1 when it runs the suite, so every deploy runs them. --test-timeout=600000 (10 min per test) is a failure bound only, never a pass path: a test that hangs fails instead of hanging npm test, and with it deploy.sh's suite step. --test-force-exit ends each test file's process once its tests have finished: from Node 26 a test cancelled at its bound no longer takes its file's process with it, so a handle it left open (an interval) kept that file, and the run, alive.
